title: Where The Options Market Is Pointing Next
speaker: Anthony and Shawn (Geeks of Finance)

macro_themes.view: Monthly OpEx week has a historically positive bias; S&P pinned at the 7800 gamma strike.
VIX in positive GEX and closing above its HMA hints at a VIX low and choppier indices into VIX expiration.
Reversal day in AI infrastructure names off key moving averages is a positive for the trade.

calls.reason: Largest gamma at 7800, bullish flow at 7850 (new highs), positive OpEx-week seasonality, drifting toward 8000 into year-end.
calls.quote: We've been drifting up towards that 8000 level for the last several months, still an important factor heading into year-end.

calls.condition: Once VIX gets above 16, it opens the door to 20.
calls.reason: VIX flipped to positive GEX and closed above its daily HMA, which previously marked VIX lows.
calls.quote: Once we get above 16, that really opens the door, you know, potentially to seeing the VIX go to 20.

calls.condition: Especially if it opens near and reclaims the 20-day SMA ~608.18.
calls.reason: Bullish reversal candle above the 50-day EMA with positive gamma and positive options flow.
calls.quote: reclaiming 20-day SMA, I think we could see a big rebound to the upside

calls.condition: Below the 50-day EMA with GEX just negative; historically a bounce zone.
calls.reason: Looks worse than AMD after breaking the 50-day EMA, but this setup has been a bounce zone before.
calls.quote: Those have been bounce zones historically in the previous months.

calls.reason: Bounced off its 50-day EMA in a broad AI-infrastructure reversal.
calls.quote: I think this is a positive, not a negative for the AI infrastructure trade.

calls.condition: As long as Google holds 350 the most bullish picture stays alive; 340 still constructive.
calls.reason: GEX in strongly positive territory with concentration toward 400; holding above all moving averages; bought the Nov 20 370/380 call debit spread.
Bounced off the 20-day SMA with positive GEX up to 800; holding sold Nov 20 700/690 put credit spreads betting it stays above 700.
calls.quote: our bet is essentially that Meta is going to stay above the 700 level in the coming weeks

notes: OpEx-week Monday/Tuesday close; no explicit date. GOOGL target is the upper strike of their 370/380 call spread. META entry was ~719.32 on Oct 8 (held position).
